test_title: PYST 14: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 23 Feb, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
The sentence has been divided into three parts, identify the segment which contains a spelling error in the sentence given below. Choose no error if there is no error in the sentence.

The college relied on the/ patronege of its wealthy graduates/ to expand its funds.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the spelling error in the word "**patronege**."
 
• The correct spelling should be "**patronage**."
 
• The word **"patronage"** refers to **the support given by a patron.**
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 2** of the sentence.

**Correct Sentence:** ***"The college relied on the patronage__ of its wealthy graduates to expand its funds."***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "no error"** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is a spelling error in Option 2.
 
• **Option 3: "to expand its funds."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 4: "The college relied on the,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
